authoring.name: Electric Swatter
authoring.description: Mint elliptical safety frame, coral textured grip, and open three-dimensional diagonal metal lattice.
notes: Reference: electric-swatter-v1.png. S=.28 miniature metre scale.
Wire lattice consists of actual four-sided metal rods with front/back crossing clearance, plus two structural supports.
The wire plane has a true 23 mm design-scale thick mint frame and an open interior; it is not a texture or alpha card.
Status light uses the third shared material kind glow. Spark and heat effects attach at swatter_hit_spark and are runtime responsibilities.
